description: This Java source file defines the class FindByPrimaryKey, which implements an entity lookup operation based on a primary key within a mini-language framework of the OFBiz project. It provides mechanisms to locate an entity by primary key, possibly with selected fields and caching options, and integrates with the OFBiz entity engine.

classes.name: FindByPrimaryKey
classes.description: Implements an entity lookup operation in the mini-language, retrieving an entity by primary key with options for selected fields and caching.

classes.name: FindByPrimaryKeyFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of FindByPrimaryKey based on XML element configuration.

methods.description: Performs the entity lookup by primary key, setting the result in the environment map.

methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the entity name involved.
